most_relevant_events.subject: Broad rebound with oil-price relief
most_relevant_events.facts: All three major US indexes rallied more than2%. WTI settled$86.85(-4.38%); Brent$92.57(-5.85%). CNBC frames lower oil and tech recovery after prior volatility as support. Dow rose above ElectionDay close while S&P/Nasdaq remained slightly below.
most_relevant_events.Ashare_implication: Overseas market breadth and lower crude offer opening risk-appetite support and cost relief for downstream users; not proof a durable equity bottom or confirmed diplomatic deal.

most_relevant_events.subject: NVIDIA board launches independent investigation; individual stock diverges
most_relevant_events.official_statement: Board initiating independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been target of a foreign intelligence effort; independent directors and outside counsel oversee inquiry.
essential_limits: Board says it has no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised.
Board expresses confidence in Jensen and leadership team; Huang supports and will cooperate.
Claims concerning alleged intelligence status are reporting/allegations, not a completed investigation finding.
No confirmed customer capex cut or orders lost by Chinese optical suppliers from this statement.
most_relevant_events.Ashare_implication: Direct new issuer-governance/key-person uncertainty explains sector divergence as market context; do not generalize NVDA decline into semiconductor or optical demand collapse or assign exact causal contribution.
